findings.summary: Reuse cppArrayDeclaration with an immutable span result for frozen numeric streams, and store column descriptors in static arrays. This removes generated vector allocation/copying and omits unused size streams from observation-only systems.
Cache the baked and frozen system pointers when registering a retained bridge, removing repeated linear searches from each renderer update and secondary blend pass.
Reuse bbl::js::array_has_index for frozen-column lookup instead of duplicating finite, fractional and bounds checks.
Compare frozen column names through string_view, avoiding repeated string construction for every candidate.
Prepare stored ray-option metadata once before visiting option fields instead of copying it for each property.
Remove unreachable nonfinite frozen-value emission branches and their limits include; the bake already refuses these values and doubleLiteral enforces that boundary.

reviewExecution.scope: Complete checkpoint diff against origin/main, including working changes; cleanup and measured status additions reviewed before the final sweep.
reviewExecution.model: All subagents inherited the parent model.
reviewExecution.scheduling: Reuse, simplification and efficiency ran concurrently. Altitude ran as a separate fourth pass after efficiency because the host permits only three child agents.
reviewExecution.altitude: No actionable findings; tuple facts, ray sequencing/filtering and particle observation/sync remain at their owning boundaries.
reviewExecution.validation: Build and 724 focused tests passed without skips, including the real native bridge and CSG transport. Four existing particle generation cases remained byte-identical to origin/main.
